title: 350_MAA06_Frustrated_v2
style: Funk-pop track in G major at 115 BPM. The arrangement features a syncopated electric bass line with a bright, percussive tone that emphasizes the downbeat before jumping into sixteenth-note ghost notes. A clean, single-coil electric guitar plays staccato funk scratches and muted ninth chords. The drum kit uses a tight, dry snare and a punchy kick drum. A brass section consisting of trumpet and saxophone provides rhythmic stabs and melodic flourishes. Male vocals are delivered in a rhythmic, soulful style with frequent use of falsetto ad-libs. The production is clean with minimal reverb, focusing on the rhythmic interplay between the bass and the guitar.
